steps.text:
This is the normal starting position, seen from White's side.

There should be four arrows (blue e2 to e4, red d7 to d5, black g1 to f3, light gold b8 to c6), each with a thin white edge, and two shaded squares (e4 gold, d5 red).

steps.ask: All 32 pieces drawn, white at the bottom, small letters and numbers on the edge squares?
Could you tell all four arrow colours apart, and see both shaded squares, on the previous screen? (Use the back arrow to look again.)
options: No, something was hard to see

steps.text: The same position seen from Black's side. The white pieces should now be at the top, and the squares e2 and e4 should be tinted gold as the last move.

steps.ask: On the previous screen: board flipped (white pieces at the top), with e2 and e4 tinted gold?
Did the small back arrow (←) take you to the previous screen when you tried it?

cards.sub: nothing to answer except the checks

steps.ask: Tap both white knights, then press Done.
steps.rtext: Both knights should now be shaded blue, each with a tick.

steps.ask: Each tapped square got a dark outline, the button counted them, and after Done both turned blue with a tick and “Found 2 of 2”?
Now get it wrong on purpose: tap the knight on b1 and the rook on a1, then Done.
steps.rtext: Expected: b1 blue with a tick (found), g1 red with a cross (missed), a1 gold with a plus (extra).

steps.ask: One blue tick, one red cross, one gold plus, a legend under the text, and a blue arrow from g1?
options: Yes, and the three were easy to tell apart
Yes, but hard to tell apart

steps.ask: Tap nothing. Press the button, which should read “None of them”.
With nothing tapped the button read “None of them”, and the verdict was “Right, nothing”?
Tap the pawn on e2, then Done.
steps.rtext: The pawn should now stand on e4.
steps.text: The next answer should change the board.

steps.ask: After Done the board itself changed, with the pawn on e4?
Tapping a selected square a second time un-selected it? (Restart the card to try, if you did not notice.)
Play e4: tap the pawn on e2, then the square e4.
The pawn got an outline when tapped, moved to e4, “Right.” appeared, and a red arrow e7 to e5 was drawn?

alt.e2e3: This is the neutral message for e3.

steps.ask: The move wanted is d4, but do the four things above first.

bad.g1f3: This is the specific message for Nf3.

steps.hint: this is the hint text: the queen's pawn.
steps.text:
Four things in order on this screen.

1. Play Nf3 (g1 then f3): a specific message about Nf3.

2. Play e3 (e2 then e3): “Not wrong”.

3. Press Hint.

4. Press Show me.
steps.wrong: This is the general wrong-move message.

steps.ask: Nf3 gave “Not that one” with the specific message, and the piece did not move?
e3 gave “Not wrong” with the neutral message?
Hint showed the hint text, and Show me then moved the pawn to d4 with “Shown”?

e7e8q.note: A white queen should stand on e8.

steps.ask: Promote: tap the pawn on e7, then e8.
A queen appeared on e8?
Do not move anything. Press “Nothing wins a piece”.
“Right.” with the nothing-there text?

cards.sub: tap the piece, then the square

steps.ask: Is this the starting position? Answer No on purpose.
Three buttons, then “Not quite” with the explanation, and both kings shaded blue?
The button “I think the key is wrong” appeared under the answer and changed to “Flagged, thanks” when pressed?

steps.text: A textbook rook ending, White to move. Press each of the two buttons once, look at what Lichess shows, come back, then press Won and Lost once each.

steps.ask: “Play it against the computer”: what did Lichess show?
options: Lichess opened, wrong position or no setup

steps.ask: “Open the board”: what did Lichess show?
Back on the card, did pressing Won and Lost add an “Attempts so far” line?
Did the links open in a new tab or in the Lichess app, so that coming back kept your place?
options: No, the page reloaded or lost my place

steps.text:
Under the board there is a blue link, “The real game”. On real cards it opens your game at that move; here it just opens a Lichess board.

At the very bottom are three buttons: ← Card, Restart card, Card →. Try ← Card (it goes to test 5), then come forward again.

steps.ask: The blue link opened Lichess?
← Card and Card → moved between cards, and Restart card went back to this card's first screen?
The bar at the top (← All, the deck name, 6 / 9) stayed in view while scrolling?
Text size comfortable to read, and buttons easy to hit with a thumb?

steps.ask: The progress bars filled as you went, and each Next jumped back to the top of the card?
Tap all sixteen white pieces and pawns as fast as you can, then Done.
steps.rtext: All sixteen should be blue with ticks.

steps.ask: Every tap registered, with no lag and no accidental zooming or text selection?
options: No, the page zoomed or selected text

steps.text:
Press ← All at the top. The test page should say how many of the 9 cards you have answered.

Then close this tab completely, open the link again, and check that the count is still there. Come back to this card to answer.

steps.ask: The count on the test page matched what you had done?
After closing and reopening the tab, the count was still there?
